# <playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Will scan Simple Note notes matching 'Fincher' and extract movie titles with director David Fincher.</uncertainty>

pw_map = {d['account_name']: d['password'] for d in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
simple_note_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='joyce-weav@gmail.com', password=pw_map['simple_note'])['access_token']

# fetch all note ids matching Fincher
all_notes=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_note_token, query='Fincher', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-updated_at')
    print('page', page_index, 'n', 0 if not page else len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_notes.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print('total', len(all_notes))

fincher_notes=[]
for n in all_notes:
    if 'Fincher' in (n.get('title') or ''):
        fincher_notes.append(n)

print('note_titles_with_Fincher', [n['note_id'] for n in fincher_notes])

movie_titles=[]

for n in all_notes:
    nid=n['note_id']
    note=apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=nid, access_token=simple_note_token)
    content=note.get('content','')
    if 'Fincher' not in content:
        continue
    print('--- note',nid, note['title'],'contains Fincher ---')
    # Extract patterns where a title line is followed by ' - director: David Fincher'
    lines=content.splitlines()
    for i in range(len(lines)-1):
        title_candidate=lines[i].strip()
        director_line=lines[i+1].strip()
        if not title_candidate:
            continue
        if director_line.lower().startswith('- director:') and 'david fincher' in director_line.lower():
            # title_candidate must be a movie title (ignore bullets like '-' or '#')
            if not title_candidate.startswith('-') and not title_candidate.startswith('#') and title_candidate.lower() not in ['director:','- director:']:
                # remove any trailing punctuation
                movie_titles.append(title_candidate)
    # Also catch multi-line where director line appears without immediate title line
    # e.g., 'Fight Club' might be on its own line anyway.

# dedupe while preserving order
seen=set(); ordered=[]
for t in movie_titles:
    if t not in seen:
        seen.add(t); ordered.append(t)

print('extracted', len(ordered), ordered)
